title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive (BDE)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad – Onsite

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
Fresher / 0–1 Year

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**Office Hours:**
10:00 AM – 6:30 PM

We’re Hiring Someone Who Can Talk, Connect & Close.

Not looking for 5 years of experience.

We’re looking for someone who is
**confident, curious, sharp with communication, and hungry to grow.**

If you can start a conversation, understand what a client actually needs, follow up without giving up, and learn how business works — you’ll fit right in.

At
**Consultup India**
, you’ll work with founders, startups, and businesses looking for support around funding, government schemes, investor readiness, and business growth.

What You’ll Do

* Connect with inbound leads and potential clients
* Understand their business and requirements
* Explain Consultup India’s services clearly
* Schedule discovery and advisory calls
* Follow up with prospects through calls and WhatsApp
* Maintain lead and follow-up records
* Work towards monthly sales and conversion targets
* Coordinate with advisors and internal teams
* Build professional relationships with founders and business owners
* Handle the complete sales journey:

**Lead → Conversation → Follow-up → Closure**

Who Can Apply?

**Freshers are absolutely welcome.**

You should apply if you:

* Have good English and Hindi communication skills
* Are comfortable speaking with new people
* Have confidence on calls
* Don’t hesitate to follow up
* Are willing to learn sales and business development
* Can work with targets
* Are disciplined, presentable, and professional
* Want to build a career in sales, consulting, startups, or business development

**BBA / B.Com / MBA / PGDM / Any Graduate can apply.**

Your degree matters.

But your
**communication, attitude, consistency, and willingness to learn matter even more.**

You’ll Love This Role If…

You’re the kind of person who thinks:

**“Give me the lead. I’ll figure out how to start the conversation.”**

You enjoy talking to people, understanding different businesses, building relationships, and converting conversations into opportunities.

What You’ll Learn

This is not just a calling job.

You’ll get practical exposure to:

* Startup ecosystem
* Government grants & schemes
* Investor funding
* Business consulting
* Client acquisition
* Sales strategy
* Negotiation
* Sales psychology
* CRM & pipeline management
* Lead qualification
* Follow-up strategy
* Founder-level conversations
* Deal closures

Compensation

**During Probation:**
₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**Post Confirmation:**
₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month

**+ Performance-Based Incentives**

Growth will be based on
**performance, communication, consistency, target achievement, and overall ownership.**

What We’re Not Looking For

❌ “I’m a fresher, so I don’t know anything.”

That’s okay.

What we’re looking for is:

✅
**“I’m a fresher, but I’m ready to learn fast.”**

We can teach you the process.

You need to bring the
**energy, discipline, communication, and hunger to grow.**

Ready to Start Your Career?

If
**sales, startups, business, and growth**
excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

**Apply now and start building your career with Consultup India.**

title: International Sales Executive
company: GMDT Marine & Industrial Engineering Pvt. Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
GMDT Marine & Industrial Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a leading power solution provider serving marine and industrial segments with custom-built applications. The company acts as a full-service provider and system integrator, offering a wide range of products including generators, control panels, motors, transformers, pumps, cables, LED lighting, automation, instrumentation, solar systems, and protection solutions. GMDT operates under strict quality control standards that meet major marine and industrial classification requirements and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification. Each project is customized to client needs, supported by strong engineering and project management capabilities in India and overseas. The company has branches across India and international locations such as Dubai.

**Role Description**
The International Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role focuses on identifying and developing international business opportunities, building new customer relationships, and expanding existing accounts in marine and industrial markets. Daily tasks include managing the sales cycle from lead generation to closing, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with technical and engineering teams, and ensuring timely follow-up with clients. The executive will maintain regular communication with overseas customers, provide high-quality customer service, and support post-sales activities to ensure satisfaction and repeat business. The role also involves market research, attending industry events as required, and contributing to sales forecasts and reporting.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in International Sales and International Business for developing and managing overseas markets.
* Candidates should possess skills in Sales and Account Management for handling the complete sales cycle and long-term client relationships.
* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills to ensure responsive, professional support to global clients.
* Experience in marine, industrial engineering, or power solutions sales is highly beneficial.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Ability to travel internationally as required and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Proven track record in achieving sales targets and working with international customers.

📩
**Interested candidates:**
Please share your updated resume on hr@gmdtengineering.com or 99099 39844 or connect with us on LinkedIn.

If you have experience in international sales and are looking for your next career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!

title: Deputy Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Support portfolio quality and X-bucket management through pre-due and pre-bounce customer engagement, timely repayment reminders, follow-up on assigned overdue cases and escalation to the Sales Manager and Collections team.
* Execute assigned activities directly and maintain accurate system records.
* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

title: Sales Compensation & Incentive Analyst
description:
Company: Qualitrol
  
  
Location: India
  
  
Reports To: Manager, Revenue Operations
  
  
**About Qualitrol**
Qualitrol is the global leader in electrical condition monitoring and protection solutions, trusted by utilities in more than 120 countries. Since 1945, we have pioneered innovations that deliver real-time insights, prevent failures, and ensure the reliability of the world's energy grid. With over 4 million installations worldwide, our monitoring technologies safeguard critical assets, extend equipment life, and reduce operational risk. Our expert service teams bring decades of hands-on experience, offering diagnostics, training, and consulting to help customers make smarter, data-driven decisions. Represented on global standards bodies, Qualitrol is recognized as a trusted advisor shaping the future of grid reliability. For over 80 years, our mission has remained clear: protecting power systems with reliable solutions that keep the lights on.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Sales Compensation & Incentive Analyst to own individual salesperson quota/target-setting together with administration of Qualitrol's Sales Incentive Plan (SIP). These two are deliberately owned by the same seat: quotas set the targets SIP pays against, and keeping target-setting and payout execution together avoids the misalignment that comes from splitting them across two roles. This role ensures reps are paid accurately and on time, resolves compensation exceptions and legacy issues, and partners with Revenue Operations and sales leadership on comp plan design as the sales organization scales.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own individual salesperson quota/target allocation in direct coordination with SIP design, ensuring targets and incentive execution are built together rather than handed off sequentially.
* Administer monthly SIP payment processing and reconciliation, ensuring accuracy and timeliness each pay cycle.
* Work with US Finance and Payroll on each payout cycle; the Manager, Revenue Operations signs off quotas and handles escalations with sales leadership.
* Maintain sales credit and project-sharing rules for deals involving multiple reps or teams.
* Support annual comp plan design and communication, including the SIP Plan Communication Document and Compensation Standard.
* Own the new-hire guarantee program, administering and tracking pay guarantees during a new rep's ramp period.
* Resolve compensation exceptions, including special booking and compensation adjustments.
* Investigate and resolve legacy compensation issues, including outstanding partial-pay discrepancies from prior plan years.
* Maintain sales operations compensation policies, exceptions, and audit evidence in support of internal controls and audit requirements.
* Support individual compensation plan updates tied to specific growth targets for select sales roles.
* Advise leadership on the structure and changes to compensation and incentives to drive engagement and outperformance in the sales organization.

**Additional Requirements**

* Regular availability during agreed hours that overlap the US Eastern workday, for payout cycles, meetings, workshops and sales leadership reviews.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in sales compensation administration, commissions, HR/finance operations, or a related analytical role.
* Strong Excel and data reconciliation skills.
* Experience working with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP (Oracle) data.
* High attention to detail and sound judgment handling sensitive compensation information.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience drafting clear plan documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with quota-setting, territory allocation, or sales planning in coordination with an incentive plan.
* Experience administering a formal sales incentive compensation management (ICM) tool or process.
* Familiarity with a Salesforce-Oracle integrated environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for independently managing day-to-day accounting activities, including vendor and customer reconciliations, payment processing, collections follow-ups, accounting entries, and month-end closing support.

The candidate should have strong MS Excel skills, good accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to manage responsibilities with minimal supervision while coordinating effectively with internal teams, vendors, customers, and other stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable activities.
* Verify vendor invoices, supporting documents, and approvals.
* Process vendor payments as per agreed timelines and payment terms.
* Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate records of outstanding payables.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices, payments, and account-related queries.
* Ensure timely accounting of expenses and vendor transactions.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Manage day-to-day Accounts Receivable activities.
* Prepare and maintain customer invoices and receivable records.
* Perform regular customer ledger reconciliations.
* Track outstanding receivables and follow up with customers for collections.
* Maintain accurate ageing reports and monitor overdue payments.
* Coordinate with internal teams and customers to resolve billing and payment discrepancies.
* Ensure timely recording and allocation of customer receipts.

General Accounting & Month-End Activities

* Pass and maintain accurate accounting entries in the accounting system.
* Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain account schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
* Assist with MIS and periodic financial reports.
* Identify discrepancies and ensure timely resolution.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required information and documentation.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of accounting records.

MS Excel & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain AP/AR trackers, ageing reports, reconciliation statements, and MIS reports.
* Use MS Excel for data analysis, reconciliation, reporting, and accounting-related activities.
* Work with Excel functions such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS, IF, filters, sorting, and data validation.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and reports.

Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with internal departments for invoice approvals, payments, collections, and reconciliations.
* Communicate with vendors and customers regarding account-related queries.
* Work closely with the Accounts/Finance team to ensure smooth and timely financial operations.

**Requirements**

* 1–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Finance, AP, AR, or General Accounting.

* Experience in vendor and customer reconciliations.

* Strong MS Excel skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Anderson Global is a leading global provider of corporate and professional services, supporting entrepreneurs, SMEs, and investors across key markets including the UAE (Dubai), India, Singapore, France, Germany, Switzerland, the USA, and the Cayman Islands. With a team of over 700 professionals and a strong acquisition-led growth strategy, the group delivers integrated services across bookkeeping, accounting, tax, legal, compliance, and corporate advisory, tailored to meet the evolving needs of businesses operating internationally.

**Associate with Active Bean Counter**

Active Bean Counter Private Limited is part of Anderson Global, a global group providing specialized financial, accounting, and operational services to businesses across multiple jurisdictions. Following its acquisition in February 2025, Active Bean Counter contributes to the Group’s finance and accounting capabilities, supporting entrepreneurial and middle-market businesses through tailored services designed to meet their specific business needs.

The company works in collaboration with Anderson Global’s international network to deliver consistent, efficient, and reliable financial and accounting solutions, aligned with applicable local requirements and global standards.

**Position Overview**

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date ledgers.

· Process invoices, verify discrepancies, and issue payments.

· Reconcile accounts payable and receivable.

· Reconcile bank statements and resolve any discrepancies.

**Financial Reporting**

· Prepare and analyze financial statements regularly, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow

statements.

· Generate and distribute timely financial reports to management.

**Budgeting**

· Assist in the preparation of budgets and forecasts.

· Monitor and track budget variances.

**VAT Compliance**

· Assist in the preparation of tax returns and ensure compliance with relevant tax regulations.

· Stay updated on changes in VAT laws and regulations.

**Audit Support**

· Collaborate with internal and external auditors during audits.

· Provide necessary documentation and explanations.

**Vendor and Custom Relations**

· Communicate with vendors and customers regarding financial transactions.

· Resolve any billing or payment discrepancies.

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

· 2+ years of experience

**Skills and Competencies**

· Strong financial analysis and accounting skills

· Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

· Ability to effectively communicate complex financial information

· Experience in providing accounting and advisory services

· Proficiency in accounting software and MS Office

· Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

· Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Sr. Key Account Manager
description:
**Role Description**

 

The Key Account Manager for Smart Manufacturing Platform and solutions is responsible for managing and growing key client accounts within region and grow specific vertical all India. This role requires a deep understanding of smart manufacturing technologies, a strong knowledge of the manufacturing industry, and the ability to build and maintain strategic relationships with clients. The Senior Key Account Manager will collaborate with internal (Customer Success, Subject Matter Expert, IoT Application Engineering team) and external (Chief Digital Officer, Plant Head, Mechanical, Reliability, Process and Electrical Head) stakeholders to drive the adoption of smart manufacturing solutions, ensure client satisfaction, and achieve sales targets.
 

**Job Profile**

 

* **Sales and Revenue Generation:**
  Achieve sales targets by effectively presenting and selling the company's solutions to key clients. Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and acquire new enterprise clients.
* **Client Relationship Management:**
  Build and nurture relationships with key clients in the enterprise sector. Serve as the primary point of contact and develop a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and goals.
* **Strategic Account Planning:**
  Develop and implement strategic account plans to identify opportunities for growth, upselling, and cross-selling. Work with clients to align their business objectives with the company's products and services.
* **Collaboration and Coordination:**
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product development, and customer support, to ensure client satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Coordinate resources to address client needs and deliver commitments.
* **Customer Advocacy:**

title: Deputy Manager / Manager – Field Sales Training & Capability Development
description:
Deputy Manager / Manager – Field Sales Training & Capability Development

**Department:**
Sales / Learning & Development

**Designation:**
Deputy Manager / Manager

**Function:**
Field Sales Capability Building & Training

Major Purpose of the Job

To enhance the productivity and effectiveness of the field sales force through structured learning interventions, on-the-job coaching, capability development, and continuous performance improvement. The role will focus on building sales competencies, strengthening execution excellence, improving market performance, and developing a sustainable learning culture across the assigned business units.

Key Responsibilities & Principal Accountabilities

1. Sales Capability Building & Development

* Drive end-to-end capability-building initiatives for field sales teams across assigned business units.
* Identify training needs through Training Need Analysis (TNA), Training Need Identification (TNI), field observations, business reviews, and performance data.
* Design, develop, and deliver customized training programs for customer-facing roles, including sales representatives, territory sales teams, and frontline sales managers.
* Strengthen selling skills, product knowledge, communication, negotiation, objection handling, distribution management, and customer engagement capabilities.
* Build a structured learning roadmap aligned with business priorities and sales performance objectives.

2. Field Coaching & Sales Effectiveness

* Conduct regular field visits, joint market working, and on-the-job coaching to assess sales team effectiveness and execution quality.
* Coach field sales teams on sales call effectiveness, outlet coverage, product availability, merchandising, visibility, and execution of sales priorities.
* Work closely with frontline sales managers to strengthen coaching, feedback, performance management, and team development skills.
* Identify capability gaps in underperforming territories and implement targeted improvement plans to enhance sales productivity.
* Support the sales team in improving key business KPIs, including sales achievement, productive calls, outlet coverage, distribution, and execution compliance, as applicable to the business.

3. Learning Calendar & Program Management

* Prepare and execute an annual and monthly capability-building calendar in consultation with key business stakeholders.
* Plan, coordinate, and deliver classroom, virtual, digital, and on-the-job training interventions.
* Ensure timely execution, participation, and completion of all planned learning initiatives.
* Develop standardized training content, facilitator guides, assessment tools, field coaching checklists, and learning materials.
* Collaborate with Sales, HR/L&D, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of learning initiatives with business requirements.

4. Foundation Learning Program (FLP) & New Hire Onboarding

* Lead the Foundation Learning Program (FLP) for new hires to ensure structured onboarding and faster role readiness.
* Design and implement 30/60/90-day learning, engagement, assessment, and evaluation plans.
* Ensure effective induction covering product knowledge, sales processes, market understanding, systems, policies, and execution standards.
* Track new-hire progress through assessments, field observations, manager feedback, and performance reviews.
* Drive refresher and reinforcement programs to ensure sustained application of learning on the job.

5. Continuous Learning & Digital Enablement

* Develop and implement continuous learning initiatives using digital learning platforms and technology-enabled solutions.
* Promote microlearning, e-learning modules, virtual sessions, digital assessments, and mobile-based learning content.
* Drive digitization and standardization of training processes, learning records, and capability assessments.
* Encourage a culture of self-learning, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development among field sales teams.

6. Training Effectiveness & Business Impact

* Develop and implement a structured training impact measurement framework covering Level 1 (Reaction), Level 2 (Learning), and Level 3 (Behaviour/Application).
* Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, field observations, manager feedback, and post-training performance tracking.
* Monitor key learning and capability metrics, including training coverage, completion, assessment scores, knowledge retention, and application on the job.
* Analyse the impact of training interventions on relevant sales productivity and business performance indicators.
* Prepare periodic MIS, dashboards, and reports highlighting training effectiveness, capability gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish a two-way feedback mechanism with field teams, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve learning interventions.

7. Stakeholder Management & Continuous Improvement

* Partner with Sales Leadership and frontline managers to identify business challenges and translate them into actionable learning solutions.
* Review capability gaps and training outcomes with key stakeholders and recommend corrective actions.
* Benchmark training practices, introduce innovative learning methodologies, and continuously enhance program effectiveness.
* Ensure consistency in training standards, content quality, delivery methodology, and learning evaluation across assigned locations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Execution of the annual/monthly training calendar.
* Training coverage, participation, and completion rates.
* Improvement in pre- and post-training assessment scores.
* Effectiveness of new-hire onboarding and 30/60/90-day evaluations.
* Improvement in field coaching effectiveness and sales capability scores.
* Application of learning and behavioural improvement in the field.
* Contribution of capability-building initiatives to relevant sales productivity and business KPIs.
* Training impact measurement, stakeholder feedback, and reporting accuracy.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of field sales operations and sales execution.
* Expertise in sales training, capability development, and field coaching.
* Strong facilitation, presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyse sales performance data and identify capability gaps.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, reporting dashboards, and digital learning tools.
* Ability to design structured learning programs and measure training effectiveness.
* Strong planning, execution, problem-solving, and project management skills.

Experience & Qualification

Every manufacturing plant runs on thousands of machines that, until recently, could not tell anyone how they were feeling. MachineAstro changes that.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Anantara Atelier is a design-focused studio dedicated to elevating interiors with global inspiration and a strong emphasis on serenity and balance. Guided by the philosophy of “Infusing Zen into Design,” the company creates spaces that blend aesthetic appeal with a calm, mindful atmosphere. Its work centers on transforming interiors into harmonious environments that support wellbeing and comfort. Team members collaborate closely to bring thoughtful, detail-oriented design solutions to clients. Applicants can expect a creative, quality-driven workplace that values innovation and refined interior experiences.

**Role Description**
We are seeking a skilled Lead Generation Specialist with hands-on expertise in both
**Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads**
. The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and monitoring paid advertising campaigns to generate qualified leads for our interior design and turnkey projects.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, lead generation strategies, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.Key Responsibilities

**1. Meta Ads Management**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
* Develop effective audience targeting strategies based on demographics, interests, locations, and buyer intent.
* Run lead generation, website conversion, remarketing, and retargeting campaigns.
* Test different ad creatives, copy, audiences, and campaign objectives to improve performance.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets to achieve lower cost per qualified lead.

**2. Google Ads Management**

* Plan and manage Google Search, Display, and other relevant Google Ads campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent search terms relevant to interior design and turnkey interior services.
* Optimize bidding strategies, ad copies, audience targeting, and campaign structure.
* Monitor search terms, negative keywords, conversion tracking, and landing page performance.
* Improve lead quality while maintaining an efficient cost per acquisition.

**3. Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Develop and implement digital strategies to generate consistent, high-quality leads.
* Focus on lead generation for 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, and premium residential interior projects.
* Understand the target audience, customer journey, and factors influencing purchase decisions.
* Coordinate with the sales team to track lead quality, follow-ups, site visits, and booking conversions.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.

**4. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS), where measurable.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Use Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager as required.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking and identify areas for campaign improvement.
* Allocate budgets based on campaign performance and business priorities.

**5. Creative & Marketing Coordination**

* Work with the internal design and content team to develop effective ad creatives, videos, reels, and campaign concepts.
* Provide creative briefs based on campaign performance and audience insights.
* Suggest new marketing strategies, offers, and campaigns to improve lead generation.
* Stay updated with digital advertising trends, platform changes, and competitor activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing and paid lead generation.
* Strong practical expertise in both
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Proven experience generating leads for real estate, interior design, home interiors, architecture, or other high-value services is preferred.
* Good understanding of audience segmentation, remarketing, conversion tracking, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion APIs is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed decisions.
* Understanding of landing pages, lead forms, keyword research, and conversion rate optimization.
* Ability to manage advertising budgets and deliver measurable results.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with the sales and creative teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified leads generated per month.
* Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead.
* Lead quality and relevance to the company's services.
* Lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.
* Campaign performance and advertising budget efficiency.
* Accuracy of tracking, reporting, and performance analysis.
* Consistency in achieving agreed monthly lead generation targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Can independently manage Meta and Google Ads without relying entirely on an external marketing agency.
* Understands the difference between generating a high volume of leads and generating leads that actually convert into business.
* Is confident in analyzing campaign data and making performance-driven decisions.
* Takes ownership of advertising budgets, lead quality, and campaign results.
* Is proactive, creative, analytical, and focused on business growth.

title: Business Development Manager, Corporate Spaces
description:
Business Development Manager, Corporate Spaces (Office Interior Solutions)

**Company:**
Arcedior

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with regular client travel across Gujarat and key metros

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor | Hunter Role with Closing Target

**Reporting To:**
COO (to be confirmed)

**Experience Required:**
8–14 years

**Preferred Notice Period:**
60 days or less

**Compensation:**
Fixed salary plus quarterly variable linked to closed order value and collected margin. Compensation range to be confirmed by Arcedior.

About Arcedior

Arcedior is a luxury interior design and contract manufacturing company helping clients create thoughtfully designed spaces through design expertise and manufacturing capabilities.

About the Role

Arcedior is looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive corporate office interior projects and establish the corporate vertical as a predictable revenue stream.

Corporate office fit-outs are high-value, repeatable and relationship-driven opportunities. With in-house design and manufacturing control, Arcedior is positioned to deliver corporate interior solutions from initial client discussions through project execution.

This role will own the complete commercial journey, from the first client meeting to a signed, advance-backed contract, and ensure a smooth handover to the execution team.

The successful candidate must have a proven track record of winning and closing corporate interior projects, building decision-maker relationships, managing commercial negotiations and protecting project margins.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Generate and Build a Strong Sales Pipeline
  

* Build and maintain a named list of target accounts, including IT companies and Global Capability Centres (GCCs), BFSI, pharmaceutical and manufacturing head offices, co-working operators, developers and growing corporates.
* Conduct direct outreach to CXOs, administration and facilities heads, and corporate real estate teams.
* Develop channel relationships with architects, Project Management Consultancy (PMC) firms, real estate consultants and workplace consultants.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of qualified corporate office interior opportunities.

2. Qualify and Shape Business Opportunities
  

* Qualify every lead based on budget, timeline, decision-maker, project area and competitor presence before committing design or estimation resources.
* Lead client briefing meetings and site visits.
* Capture project requirements in a standardised brief format.
* Coordinate with design and estimation teams to develop concepts, layouts and costed proposals.

3. Pricing, Proposals and Commercial Negotiations
  

* Present proposals with clearly defined scope, exclusions, timelines and payment terms.
* Negotiate commercial terms without compromising the approved minimum gross margin.
* Close contracts with appropriate advance payments, milestone terms, retention conditions and variation clauses.
* Ensure commercial discipline throughout the sales and contract closure process.

4. Project Handover and Relationship Management
  

* Hand over a complete project package to the execution team, including signed scope, drawings, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), client contacts and commitments made.
* Remain accountable for the client relationship throughout the project.
* Manage client escalations and change requests.
* Support timely milestone billing and collections in coordination with the finance team.

5. Account Growth, Reporting and Forecasting
  

* Convert completed projects into client references, repeat orders and expansion opportunities.
* Maintain accurate weekly Customer Relationship Management (CRM) updates.
* Prepare monthly sales forecasts.
* Track competitor pricing and analyse reasons for won and lost proposals.
* Share market insights and sales learnings with the COO.

First 90-Day Expectations
  

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate a live sales pipeline by Day 30, submit proposals by Day 60, and achieve a signed order or documented verbal commitment by Day 90.

Days 1–30: Learn and Build the Pipeline
  

* Understand Arcedior's offerings, past projects, pricing and estimation methodology.
* Visit the factory and two live project sites.
* Build a list of 40 target corporate accounts and 15 channel partners.
* Secure initial client meetings.
* Submit an account list for review by the COO.

**Expected proof of progress:**
Account list reviewed by the COO, with 10 first meetings booked.

Days 31–60: Qualify and Propose
  

* Conduct at least 12 client meetings and five site visits.
* Qualify eight live business opportunities.
* Submit at least two costed proposals.

**Expected proof of progress:**
CRM records showing qualified pipeline value, stage and next steps.

Days 61–90: Negotiate and Close
  

* Negotiate two to three proposals towards a decision.
* Close the first order or secure a documented verbal commitment.
* Present a 12-month account development plan.

**Expected proof of progress:**
First contract signed with an advance payment, or a documented verbal commitment with a clear closing date.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

Performance will be reviewed monthly and measured against targets established by Arcedior before the offer.

* **Closed Order Value:**
  Value of signed corporate office interior contracts, measured in INR crore. Annual target to be set by Arcedior.
* **Pipeline Health:**
  Maintain qualified pipeline coverage of 3x to 4x the annual sales target at all times.
* **Win Rate:**
  Target of 20% to 25% of qualified proposals submitted.
* **Margin Discipline:**
  Gross margin at order must meet the approved estimate and minimum margin floor. No order should fall below the approved floor margin.
* **Cash Discipline:**
  Advance payment must be collected before project mobilisation, as per contract policy. Work must not start without the required advance.
* **Repeat Business and Referrals:**
  Target at least 25% of orders from existing clients, PMCs and architects by Month 12.
* **Account Base:**
  Maintain 25–30 named corporate accounts under active engagement.

Additional monthly KPIs include new qualified opportunities, proposals submitted, win rate, order value closed, margin at order, advances collected and CRM accuracy.

Must-Have Qualifications and Experience

Candidates must meet all the following requirements to be considered for shortlisting.

Experience and Proven Sales Performance
  

* 8–14 years of business development experience in office or commercial interiors, turnkey fit-outs, office furniture or workstation solutions.
* At least four years of direct corporate project sales experience.
* Ability to demonstrate at least three corporate projects personally won, including client name, project area in square feet, order value and year.
* Experience closing individual orders worth INR 1 crore or more, ideally up to INR 10 crore.

Corporate Relationships and Market Access
  

* Existing working relationships with corporate real estate, administration or facilities heads, PMC firms, architects or workplace consultants in Gujarat.
* A clear plan to develop business opportunities in Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru or Delhi NCR.
* Ability to identify and engage relevant corporate decision-makers.

Technical Knowledge
  

* Ability to read layouts and technical drawings.
* Understanding of complete office fit-out scope, including civil work, partitions, ceilings, flooring, electrical, HVAC, furniture and workstations.
* Ability to provide a credible rate-per-square-foot range during client discussions.

Commercial Understanding
  

* Strong understanding of BOQs, gross margins, payment milestones, retention, variations and contract risks.
* Ability to negotiate commercially while protecting profitability.
* Understanding of advance payments, project billing and collections.

Work Discipline and Communication
  

* Ability to maintain accurate CRM records and provide an honest weekly sales forecast.
* Confidence in dealing with CXOs and senior corporate decision-makers.
* Strong proposal writing and presentation skills in English.
* Professional communication skills in Hindi and Gujarati.

Education

* Graduate in any discipline.
* A degree in architecture, interior design or engineering, or an MBA, will be an advantage.

Good-to-Have Qualifications
  

* Experience with luxury or design-led office projects.
* Experience working with a manufacturer that controls its own production.
* Exposure to workplace strategy, space planning or workplace technology discussions with corporate clients.
* An existing portfolio of repeat clients that can be named and verified.
* Experience selling to Global Capability Centres (GCCs) and multinational offices with formal vendor onboarding processes.

Who Should Not Apply / Screening Criteria
  

Candidates may be screened out if they meet any of the following conditions:

* Their background is primarily in residential interiors, retail, home-furnishing sales or only lead generation and inside sales.
* They cannot name specific projects, clients and order values, or provide only team-level numbers without demonstrating their personal contribution.
* They claim to have a large professional network but cannot name five decision-makers and explain what those contacts last purchased.
* They have changed jobs more than three times in six years without demonstrating closed orders at each stop.
* They quote project rates without understanding what is included in the scope.
* They consider margin management to be solely the finance team's responsibility.

What Success Looks Like
  

The right candidate will build a strong corporate pipeline, develop long-term relationships with decision-makers, personally close high-value office interior contracts, protect margins and ensure disciplined collections.

Within the first 90 days, the candidate should demonstrate tangible commercial progress. Over the first 12 months, the objective is to establish a reliable, profitable and repeatable corporate business development channel for Arcedior.

**If you have proven experience in corporate office interiors, a strong network of decision-makers and a track record of closing high-value projects, we would like to hear from you.**

title: Head - International Sales (Coatings&Composits)-Ahmedabad
description:
Position : Head – Exports - International Sales

LOCATION: AHMEDABAD (GUJARAT)

Specialization: Coatings & Composits (Resins)

Department: International Business / Exports

Designation: Head – Exports

Reporting To: CEO / Head of Sales

Location: Ahmedabad / As per company requirements, with international travel as required

**Business Segments: Coatings and Composites**

**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and drive the company's international business growth across the Coatings and Composites segments by developing new markets, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and increasing export revenue and profitability.

The incumbent will be responsible for developing and executing the international sales strategy across the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and neighbouring countries and other potential markets. The role requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, technical product knowledge, new product development

capabilities, international business expertise, and operational excellence in export execution.

The position will also ensure coordination with CHA, efficient logistics, regulatory compliance, timely shipments, and seamless coordination across internal and external stakeholders.

2.
**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

A. International Sales and Business Development

 Develop and execute the international sales strategy for Coatings and Composites products,

aligned with the company'S business growth and profitability objectives.

 Expand the company's presence in existing export markets and establish business in new

geographies, including the Middle East, Africa, and neighbouring countries.

 Identify and develop new customers, distributors, agents, channel partners, OEMs, and strategic

business relationships.

 Drive customer acquisition, account development, market penetration, and long-term business

partnerships.

 Develop territory-wise business plans, sales forecasts, revenue targets, and customer acquisition

strategies.

 Monitor international market trends, competitor activities, pricing benchmarks, customer

requirements, and emerging business opportunities.

 Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment conditions, annual contracts, and supply

agreements to achieve sustainable business growth and margins.

**B. Technical Sales and New Product Development**

 Demonstrate strong technical understanding of specialty resins and their applications in the

Coatings and Composites industries.

 Lead technical selling by understanding customer formulations, application requirements,

performance expectations, and product specifications.

 Collaborate with R&D, Technical Services, Quality, Production, and Marketing teams to develop products tailored to international customer requirements.

 Drive the complete new product development process, from identification of market needs and

customer trials to product validation, commercialisation, and repeat business.

 Coordinate customer sampling, technical presentations, product trials, application testing, and

resolution of technical complaints.

 Identify opportunities for product differentiation, value-added solutions, and expansion into

high-potential applications and markets.

 Translate customer feedback and market intelligence into actionable product development and

innovation initiatives.

**C. International Market Development and Customer Relationship Management**

 Conduct market mapping, identify potential customer segments, assess market attractiveness,

and develop territory-specific entry strategies.

 Build and maintain strong relationships with international customers, distributors, consultants,

and business partners.

 Undertake international customer visits, exhibitions, trade fairs, industry conferences, and

business development meetings.

 Evaluate and appoint suitable channel partners and distributors, where appropriate, and

monitor their performance.

 Develop customer-specific growth plans to improve customer retention, wallet share, and long-

term business value.

 Establish a structured system for tracking leads, enquiries, quotations, samples, customer trials,

orders, and conversion ratios.

**D. Commercial, Legal and Financial Management**

 Possess sound knowledge of international trade practices, export documentation, Incoterms,

Letters of Credit, bank guarantees, foreign exchange exposure, and international payment

mechanisms.

 Evaluate customer creditworthiness, payment risks, commercial exposure, and country-specific

business risks.

 Ensure appropriate commercial terms and contractual safeguards in international sales

agreements.

 Work closely with Finance, Legal, Taxation, and banking partners on export payments, foreign

exchange realisation, credit control, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 Ensure compliance with applicable Indian export regulations, customs requirements, Foreign

Trade Policy, DGFT procedures, GST/export documentation requirements, and relevant

destination-country regulations.

 Understand applicable product registration, chemical regulatory, labelling, safety data sheet,

and other product-specific requirements in target markets.

 Monitor export incentives, trade agreements, customs duties, sanctions, and other

developments that may affect international competitiveness, wherever applicable.

E. Export Operations, Logistics and Documentation

 Oversee the end-to-end export order execution process, from order confirmation and

production coordination to dispatch, shipment, documentation, and payment realisation.

 Ensure accurate and timely preparation and submission of export documents, including

commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, certificates of origin, bills of lading, and other

applicable documents.

 Coordinate air and sea shipments, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines,

transporters, and other logistics service providers.

 Develop cost-effective and reliable logistics solutions while maintaining delivery commitments,

product quality, and customer service standards.

 Evaluate freight rates, shipping routes, container utilisation, transit times, insurance, and

logistics service provider performance.

 Coordinate with Production, Planning, Quality, Stores, Dispatch, Finance, and Customer Service

to ensure timely order fulfilment.

 Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, product identification, and handling requirements for

international transportation of chemical products.

 Proactively resolve shipment delays, documentation discrepancies, customs clearance issues,

and customer delivery escalations.

**F. Cross-Functional Leadership and Team Management**

 Build, lead, and develop a capable international sales and export operations team.

 Establish clear goals, responsibilities, performance measures, and accountability for the team.

 Work collaboratively with R&D, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and senior

management to achieve business objectives.

 Promote a customer-centric, commercially disciplined, and collaborative working culture.

 Provide regular updates to senior management on sales performance, market development,

customer pipelines, export profitability, and business risks.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The incumbent's performance will be assessed against the following parameters:

1. Export Revenue Growth: Achievement of annual and territory-wise export sales targets.

2. Profitability: Gross contribution and profitability of export business.

3. New Market Development: Successful entry into new countries, regions, and customer

segments.

4. New Customer Acquisition: Number and quality of new customers converted into commercial

business.

5. Existing Customer Growth: Customer retention, repeat orders, and account growth.

6. New Product Commercialisation: Successful conversion of product development initiatives,

trials, and samples into commercial orders.

7. Sales Pipeline Conversion: Enquiry-to-quotation, sample-to-trial, and trial-to-order conversion

rates.

8. Export Execution: On-time shipment, documentation accuracy, and adherence to committed

delivery schedules.

9. Receivables and Risk Management: Timely payment realisation, adherence to credit terms, and

control of overdue receivables.

10. Customer Satisfaction: Resolution of complaints, technical support effectiveness, and customer

feedback.

11. Compliance: Adherence to applicable export, customs, contractual, and product-specific

regulatory requirements.

12. Team Effectiveness: Achievement of team objectives, cross-functional coordination, and

capability development.

**4. Educational Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Technology, Business Administration, or a

related discipline.

 MBA or postgraduate qualification in International Business, Marketing, Sales, or Supply Chain

Management will be an advantage.

 Minimum 12+ years of experience in international sales, export business development, or

international business leadership, preferably within specialty chemicals, resins, coatings,

composites, or allied chemical industries.

 Demonstrated experience in developing international markets, acquiring new customers,

negotiating commercial agreements, and managing export operations.

 Experience in technical sales, application-based selling, and coordinating new product

development with R&D and technical teams.

 Practical understanding of international logistics, customs procedures, export documentation,

trade finance, and regulatory compliance.

**5. Required Competencies**

Commercial and Strategic

 Strong business development orientation with a demonstrated ability to identify and convert

new opportunities.

 Excellent negotiation, pricing, margin management, and commercial decision-making skills.

 Strategic thinking, market intelligence, and international business planning capabilities.

Technical and Product

 Strong understanding of specialty resins and their applications in coatings and composites.

 Ability to communicate product value propositions and technical benefits to international

customers.

 Strong customer application understanding and new product development orientation.

International Business and Communication

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 Strong presentation, interpersonal, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

 Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures, time zones, and diverse business

environments.

 Confidence in conducting international customer meetings, technical discussions, and

commercial negotiations.

**Operational and Leadership**

 Strong knowledge of export documentation, air and sea freight, customs clearance, and logistics

management.

 Sound understanding of legal, financial, contractual, and regulatory aspects of international

trade.

 Strong analytical, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

 High ownership, execution discipline, teamwork, integrity, and customer focus.

6. Expected Outcomes

The Head – Exports is expected to establish a sustainable and profitable international business for

Speciality Resins by expanding the global customer base, increasing market penetration, strengthening technical and commercial customer relationships, accelerating new product commercialisation, and ensuring reliable, compliant, and cost-effective export operations.

description: We're hiring an Inside Sales Executive at Because 📞Not a script-reader. Not a dialer-and-log person.Someone who can actually talk to a parent deciding which school to put their child in — or a family deciding whether to buy a home — and help them think it through.📍 Ahmedabad · Full-time · In-office · No WFH🗂 2–5 years experience🌐 Because — teambecause.comBecause is an AI-native brand and marketing agency. We run marketing for schools and real estate projects across Gujarat and India. That marketing generates leads. This role is about making sure those leads don't die on the phone.───────────────────The problem you'll solve:Most leads die on the phone. Someone calls, reads a script, gets a "we'll think about it", and marks the lead cold. The parent had a real question and nobody answered it.You'll be the person who actually answers it.───────────────────What you'll do:Call every new lead within minutes of it coming in. WhatsApp, calls, a real conversation after the visit.Log everything cleanly in the CRM so the next person knows exactly where the lead stands.Work alongside AI — junk leads get filtered before they reach you, WhatsApp nurture runs in parallel. You get the conversations worth having.Tell us when the marketing is wrong. This is not a nice-to-have.You can switch between all three mid-sentence, the way people here actually talkPatient with anxious, indecisive people asking the same question a third timeHonest under pressure — you won't oversell a school to a child it doesn't suitEx-teachers, ex-admission heads, ex-school coordinators very welcome───────────────────This won't work if:✗ You've only ever worked off a dialer and a script✗ You count your day in calls made rather than conversations that went somewhere✗ You'd say whatever it takes to get the visit booked✗ Gujarati, Hindi, and English aren't all genuinely comfortable for you

title: Advertising Sales Manager
description:
**About AdOnMo** 




 AdOnMo is one of India’s leading Out\-of\-Home (OOH) and Digital Out\-of\-Home (DOOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors including Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a growing network of 33,000\+ digital screens and 20,000\+ static frame posters across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our advertising solutions are deployed across high\-visibility and high\-footfall environments, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Gyms and fitness centres
* Shopping malls
* Public and commercial spaces
* Other high\-footfall locations across key markets



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping advertisers build targeted and impactful visibility through innovative OOH and DOOH advertising solutions.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for self\-driven and target\-oriented Sales Managers to generate revenue through the sale of OOH and DOOH advertising solutions.
 



 This is a field\-intensive sales role involving client acquisition, business development, client meetings, follow\-ups, relationship management, and achieving monthly revenue targets.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Key Responsibilities
 


* **1\. Sales Strategy \& Execution**
* Develop and execute business plans to achieve sales and revenue targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential areas for market expansion.
* Analyse market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities.
* Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.



  




* **2\. Client Acquisition \& Relationship Management**
* Identify and acquire new clients and business opportunities.
* Conduct sales meetings, presentations, and client discussions.
* Understand client requirements and develop suitable OOH/DOOH advertising solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and account expansion.
* Follow up with clients and agencies to ensure timely payments.



  




* **3\. Agency \& Market Development**
* Build and maintain relationships with advertising agencies, media agencies, and direct clients.
* Develop a strong network within the local advertising and business ecosystem.
* Track market opportunities and actively generate new leads.



  




* **4\. Internal Collaboration**
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of client campaigns.
* Work closely with the marketing team to support lead generation and business development initiatives.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely release and execution of client orders.



  




* **5\. Reporting \& Analysis**
* Maintain regular tracking of leads, prospects, client interactions, and business opportunities.
* Prepare daily call reports, weekly performance updates, monthly sales plans, and sales projections.
* Monitor sales performance and pipeline to ensure achievement of targets.



  




* **6\. Brand Representation**
* Represent AdOnMo professionally in client meetings, industry interactions, and other business forums.
* Promote AdOnMo’s OOH and DOOH advertising solutions to prospective clients and agencies.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Minimum 2\-5 year of experience in field sales, media, advertising, OOH, DOOH, print, digital, or related sales roles.
 


* Experience in B2B sales and client acquisition will be preferred.
* Prior experience working with advertising or media agencies is an advantage.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and target\-oriented approach.
* Strong business development and client relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently manage sales cycles and close deals.
* Good understanding of local market dynamics.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development.
* Must own a two\-wheeler or four\-wheeler for regular client visits.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Proactive, go\-getter mindset with a strong drive to achieve targets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong B2B sales and corporate sales experience.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and agencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience in the Advertising, Media, OOH, DOOH, Marketing, or Sales industry will be preferred.

 AdOnMo is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all candidates based on their skills, experience, and qualifications.

description:
**About Aipri Lifesciences LLP** 




 Established in 2025 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Aipri Lifesciences is an emerging, fast\-growing medical device company dedicated to delivering high\-quality surgical solutions. Founded and led by a medical doctor with extensive cross\-functional experience in clinical research and pharma medical affairs, Aipri bridges the gap between clinical necessity and technical excellence.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 We specialize in the technical design, material specification, and commercialization of premium surgical consumables, including advanced braided sutures (like Aicryl Polyglactin 910\) and surgical skin glue. Driven by a commitment to superior patient outcomes, we are aggressively expanding our product portfolio into a wider array of advanced medical instruments and devices.
 



  





**Our Vision \& Culture** 




 Our vision is to build Aipri into a highly respected, successful brand with a global reach. We are grounded in the core values of honesty, humility, intelligence, and kindness. At Aipri, we maintain a positive, realistic, and dependable work environment that respects the balance between ambitious business growth and personal peace of mind.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Working at Aipri means joining a forward\-thinking, doctor\-led enterprise where your contributions directly impact the healthcare ecosystem. We offer structured compensation models, a clear strategic roadmap, and a collaborative environment where disciplined, dependable, and intellectually driven professionals can thrive and build a meaningful career.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Operation Theater (OT) Engagement:** 
 Spend active time in hospital OT environments, supporting surgeons and OT teams during product evaluation to build clinical confidence in Aipri’s suture portfolio.



  




* **Surgeon \& Specialty Coverage:** 
 Build and maintain direct relationships with key surgeons across multiple specialties (General Surgery, OB\-GYN, Orthopedics).



  




* **Territory \& Account Management:** 
 Map private hospitals, nursing homes, and day\-care surgical centers in assigned Ahmedabad clusters; identify new accounts and drive repeat orders.



  




* **Institutional \& Purchase Coordination:** 
 Engage Hospital Purchase Managers, Procurement Teams, and OT Sisters\-in\-Charge to facilitate product code listings, vendor registration, and seamless ordering.



  




* **Supply \& Delivery Support:** 
 Coordinate with the internal operations team to ensure direct, next\-day product delivery to hospital clients and manage local inventory needs.



  




* **Market \& Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Track local surgeon preference shifts, competitor activity, and hospital procurement dynamics, reporting field insights directly to leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Biotechnology, or related fields.
* 1 to 3 years in Surgical Devices, Medical Consumables, OT Products, or Clinical Hospital Sales in Ahmedabad.
* Fully comfortable working within the Operation Theater (OT) environment and interacting directly with surgical teams.
* Existing contacts with surgeons, OT staff, and hospital purchase departments across key Ahmedabad surgical clusters.
* Strong scientific learning aptitude, relationship\-building skills, commercial negotiation ability, and high integrity.
* Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily local territory coverage.



  





**Field Working Structure \& Culture** 



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Field Timings: Aligned with surgeon availability and OT schedules (starts at 9:30 AM; flexible field wrap\-up based on daily doctor appointments and hospital rounds).
* Compensation: Competitive fixed salary (commensurate with experience) \+ Daily Local Conveyance Allowance (TA/DA) \+ Incentives.

title: Assistant Manager - Commercial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O\&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This position is responsible for providing exceptional service to customers, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Accounting Executive**
**Financial Accounting and Control**
* Maintain clear and organized ledgers, ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date financial records
* Set up provisions and maintain financial book hygiene to align with accounting standards and regulations
* Monitor and manage the ageing of cargo inventory to optimize inventory control and ensure timely actions
* Process refunds and manage short closures in accordance with contractual agreements
* Maintain Delivery Orders (DOs), books, credit and debit notes
* Re\-validate Delivery Orders (DOs) as needed to support smooth financial transactions
* Keep meticulous records of financial transactions related to port activities for transparent reporting
* Implement strategies to effectively manage debtors, minimize outstanding receivables, and ensure financial stability
* Monitor and control financial exposure related to mark\-to\-market (M2M) activities, mitigating risks
* Address and manage items noted in Letters of Credit (LCs) to maintain compliance with LC terms
* Accurately account for quality\-related penalty premiums in financial records
* Calculate and manage interest charges, plot rent, and financial adjustments, adhering to contractual terms


**Branch Development Strategy, Market Intelligence**
* Conduct market mapping for the select region to identify potential new key accounts and explore further potential from current key accounts
* Identify and drive new product development opportunities
* Grow and retain market share for key accounts
* "Capture market intelligence through multiple sources (field inputs, research, competition intelligence)
* \- Voice of Customer (VoC) on coal quality (customer feedback)
* \- Competitor scanning"
* Champion IRM Registration amongst existing customers and ensure new orders are done through IRM (as mandated)
* Provide market intelligence about the pricing and product details to the team along with the Chief trader
* Review existing processes and systems for identifying process/system improvements, identify new initiatives, automation, and digitization opportunities


**Customer Query Handling and Financial Reconciliation**
* Respond promptly and accurately to customer queries related to financial transactions, ensuring customer satisfaction and clarity
* Perform regular sales reconciliation to verify the accuracy of financial records, identifying and resolving discrepancies
* Process debit and credit notes associated with sales transactions to maintain complete and accurate financial documentation
* Follow compliance with Tax Collection at Source (TCS) regulations under Section 27C of the Income Tax Act to meet legal requirements
* Accurately record and manage customer payments in the financial system to maintain up\-to\-date financial records
* Track records received from external sources and input them into the IRM (Information Resource Management) system
* Prepare and manage PIS (Packed in slip) records
* Manage delivery orders, financial books, debit, and credit notes
* Process ledger entries such as LC (Letter of Credit) clearing
* Manage port reconciliations, provisions, and entries


**Digitisation and Automation**
 Support comprehensive digitization strategies to optimise operational efficiency
   

  

 Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organisational goals / strategy
   

  

**Key Stakeholders Internal**
* Finance and accounting
* Marketing
* Operations


**Key Stakeholders External**
 Customers
   

  

 Suppliers/ Vendors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education Qualification:**
* Post\-Graduation (Finance)


**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
* 0\-5 Years of experience


**Preferred Industry**
* Coal Trading, Commodity Trading

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
 



**Job Type:** 
 Internship
 



  




 About TestOwl
 
 TestOwl is a no\-code test automation platform that helps product and engineering teams reduce testing effort, minimize test maintenance, and ship faster with confidence.
 



 We are looking for a motivated
 **Sales Intern** 
 who wants hands\-on experience in B2B SaaS sales and is excited to learn how a technology product is taken from prospecting to closing.
 



  




 What You’ll Do
 
 As a Sales Intern, you will be involved across the
 **end\-to\-end sales cycle** 
 , including:
 


* Research and identify potential B2B prospects and target accounts.
* Build and maintain lead lists using online research and sales tools.
* Perform lead qualification and understand prospect requirements.
* Conduct outbound outreach through
 **LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and cold calls** 
 .
* Write and personalize outreach messages based on the prospect and company.
* Follow up with prospects and manage conversations throughout the sales process.
* Schedule and assist with product demos and sales calls.
* Understand customer pain points and communicate how TestOwl can help.
* Maintain accurate lead and prospect information in the CRM.
* Track outreach, responses, meetings, and opportunities.
* Work closely with the founder and sales team to improve prospecting and conversion strategies.
* Learn and contribute to different stages of the sales funnel, from
 **lead generation to closing** 
 .



  




 What We’re Looking For
 * Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good written and verbal English.
* Comfortable speaking with new people over calls and messages.
* Proactive, curious, and willing to take ownership.
* Ability to research companies and understand their business needs.
* Willingness to learn B2B SaaS sales and outbound sales.
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn, email, and online research.
* Prior sales experience is
 **not mandatory** 
 . We value attitude, curiosity, and the willingness to learn.



  




 What You’ll Learn
 
 This is a hands\-on opportunity to learn
 **real\-world B2B SaaS sales** 
 . You will get exposure to:
 


* Lead generation and prospect research
* Outbound sales and cold outreach
* Lead qualification
* Sales conversations and discovery
* Product demos
* Follow\-ups and objection handling
* CRM and sales pipeline management
* Conversion and sales strategy
* The complete journey from
 **prospecting to closing**



**﻿**




 You will work closely with the team and get the opportunity to understand how an early\-stage SaaS company builds its sales process and acquires customers.
 



  




 Why Join TestOwl?
 * Work directly with an early\-stage SaaS team.
* Get hands\-on exposure to the complete sales cycle.
* Learn by doing rather than only performing repetitive lead\-generation tasks.
* Opportunity to take ownership and grow with the company.
* Potential for a full\-time opportunity based on performance.
* **If you are ambitious, comfortable talking to people, and want to build a strong foundation in B2B SaaS sales, we’d love to hear from you.**
